answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax of 5 POA, a sunk cost as hard as quartz: collected at registration, never refunded, it feeds a pool rewarding honest work. A falcon-eyed verifier checks each applicant. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 500 POA and earns nothing, because each identity must first earn its keep with a new partner, like reaching an oasis. One honest agent pays 5 POA once, keeps its earnings, and shares the pool after 20 epochs.
